title: conformance/rawstub events
note: Additive only. created and archived share the aggregate type conformance.rawstub.note and the note row's version; owner_noted is published by the handler of conformance.owner.updated.v1.

envelope.description: CloudEvents 1.0 binary mode, fixed by be-protocol P12.

events.subject: conformance.rawstub.created.v1
events.note: Published by POST /notes in the creating transaction.

events.subject: conformance.rawstub.archived.v1
events.note: Published by POST /notes/{id}/archive when the note is archived.

events.subject: conformance.rawstub.owner_noted.v1
events.note: Published by the handler of conformance.owner.updated.v1 in its transaction (causation = the handled event).
